name: Opioids
tierNotes: Threshold: warmth — the golden-hour cast arrives first (early warmCast).
Light: dimming + the first shallow nod per minute.
Common: regular nod cycle — lid descends, blur and darkening ramp, snap back; pinholing visible.

Strong: deep nods to 90% black, heavy lids, syrupy tracers; uncontrolled refocus/double vision wakes up (late curve) — PsychonautWiki: eyes 'un-focus and re-focus uncontrollably... present no matter where one focuses.' The image's own edges/patterns and the pinhole boundary begin a slow, languid breathe/sway (user feedback) — dreamy, not nervous.

Heavy: near-continuous nodding with seconds of black; motion slowed throughout; constant double vision; the whole frame and its pinhole boundary sway/breathe noticeably, now joined by a genuine organic form-constant pattern (patternMask + symmetry, late curve, pushed stronger per repeated feedback) riding the scene's own texture — it passes through the same warm golden-cast pipeline as everything else, so it reads as part of the warm dream rather than a rainbow overlay; at the deepest point of each nod, soft warm hypnagogic dream imagery briefly surfaces in the blackout (PsychonautWiki: nodding 'often accompanied by vivid dream-like visions') before the snap resets it.
